lines.text: Multi-page Table
Page 1 begins the table below this six-line setup.
Page 2 contains only the continued table.
Page 3 ends the table near its midpoint.
The header repeats at each page top.
Rows use one, two, and three lines of wrapped text.
The closing control follows the final row.
ROW CONTINUOUS TABLE CONTENT
01 One-line control row 01 stays intentionally compact.
02 Two-line sample row 02 carries enough descriptive text to wrap once while preserving
alignment, padding, and row identity.
03 Three-line sample row 03 deliberately contains a longer description that wraps twice,
increases the row height, and provides a regular long-row sample for natural pagination.
04 One-line control row 04 remains compact for comparison.
05 Two-line sample row 05 adds sufficient narrative text to wrap once while its row number
remains aligned with the complete cell.
06 Three-line sample row 06 uses an extended explanation that should wrap twice, exercise
the taller cell geometry, and compare line wrapping and vertical placement across the
three output formats.
07 One-line control row 07 provides another compact baseline.
08 Two-line sample row 08 continues across a second visual line so the renderers must agree
on the resulting row height.
09 Three-line sample row 09 includes enough continuous prose to wrap twice, make the
alternating row band visibly taller, and expose any disagreement about where the next row
begins or where the page ends.
10 One-line control row 10 remains intentionally compact.
ROW CONTINUOUS TABLE CONTENT
11 Two-line sample row 11 carries enough descriptive text to wrap once while preserving the
expected cell padding and ordered row identity.
12 Three-line sample row 12 contains a longer description that wraps twice, increases the row
height, and continues the regular short, medium, and long sequence without a pagination
hint.
13 One-line control row 13 marks a compact transition point.
14 Two-line sample row 14 contains enough words for one wrap and a clearly visible increase
over the compact control rows.
15 Three-line sample row 15 carries a deliberately extended explanation that wraps twice,
tests the vertical placement of the row number, and confirms that borders and banding
grow with the text.
16 One-line control row 16 remains deliberately concise.
17 Two-line sample row 17 wraps once so continued-table pagination must account for a
variable body-row height.
18 Three-line sample row 18 supplies enough prose to wrap twice, exercise line spacing
inside the table cell, and make any clipping, overlap, or differing page-boundary behavior
visible during review.
19 One-line control row 19 offers a final compact baseline.
20 Two-line sample row 20 expands to a second line while retaining the same margins,
borders, and column widths.
21 Three-line sample row 21 uses longer continuous text that wraps twice, produces a visibly
taller band, and checks that the repeated header and following rows remain correctly
positioned after pagination.
22 One-line control row 22 remains intentionally compact.
ROW CONTINUOUS TABLE CONTENT
23 Two-line sample row 23 carries enough descriptive text to wrap once while preserving the
expected cell margins, alternating fill, and border alignment.
24 Three-line sample row 24 deliberately carries enough text to wrap twice, continues the
regular long-row pattern, and demonstrates that later rows retain their complete text,
padding, and borders.
25 One-line control row 25 is the last compact comparison.
26 Two-line sample row 26 occupies a second line before the final variable-height row and
closing control.
27 Three-line sample row 27 finishes with extended prose that wraps twice, confirms the table
can end cleanly after a taller row, and leaves the green control immediately below the
completed table.
PASS: the repeated header appears on all three pages, rows 01 through 27 appear once in order
with naturally wrapped one-, two-, and three-line text, and this control follows the table on page 3.
